industry_sector: Higher education; regulated use of student data (FERPA); high reputational stakes in admissions

management_question: Whether and how to pilot agentic AI for prospective-student engagement in the current academic year

time_horizon: 12 months: pilot decision now, evaluation within one admissions cycle
users_stakeholders: Prospective students, admissions counselors, marketing/enrollment staff, university IT and compliance officers
